resources.string: Lets Jarvis read the screen and perform taps and gestures on your behalf, so it can drive apps that have no API. Every tap or text entry is Tier 3: Jarvis asks for your explicit approval each time, showing the exact action before anything happens. Text captured from the screen is treated as untrusted data and can never trigger an action by itself.
Tier 3 actions waiting for your explicit approval. Silencing this channel means those requests time out and are denied.
The ongoing connection to your Jarvis server. Low priority; keeps the device reachable for commands.
Notifications Jarvis posts on your behalf (reminders, task results, automation output).
